meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把你已有的 claude-mem 观察记录按项目、类型、概念、文件或日期筛成一个「知识库」(corpus),加载进一段 AI 会话,然后就这批记录连续问答、追问不丢上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从历史观察记录里建一个主题知识库(比如「hooks 相关全部」),或就过去的决策、bugfix 等提问时触发。

say.text: 用 hooks 这个概念帮我建一个知识库
say.note: 运行 build_corpus 按概念筛选

say.text: 加载这个知识库,告诉我 5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发
say.note: 先 prime 再 query,可继续追问

say.text: 列出我现有的所有知识库
say.note: 运行 list_corpora,看统计与加载状态

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can filter your claude-mem observations by project, type, concept, file or date into a corpus, load it into an AI session, and answer follow-up questions from that knowledge.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a focused knowledge base built from your observation history, or want to ask about past decisions, bugfixes, etc.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base from my observations using the concept hooks
Prime that corpus and tell me when each lifecycle hook fires
say_en.note: Primes, then queries; follow-ups keep context
